description: List named entities across the connected user's Skwirl saves, rather than the posts' main topics. Read-only; optionally filter kind and set limit from 1–200 (default 50). Returns text entries with name, type, done flag when present, newest source-note title/ID and repeat count when present. Entities are deduplicated by type/name and ordered by newest source note first; ties have no guaranteed order. Returns an empty-result message if none. Use for saved books, places or people; use search_skwirl for concepts and get_skwirl_note for source details. Usage examples: list_skwirl_mentions({"kind":"book","limit":50}); list_skwirl_mentions({}). Returns text.

kind.description: Optional entity type string, one of book, movie, show, podcast, place, product, person, other; omit for all types. Example: book.

limit.description: Integer result count from 1 to 200; defaults to 50. Example: 50.

name: list_skwirl_mentions
